name: autoexec_job_phase_operation
label: Automation Job Stage Operations Table
description: Automation job stage operations table used for associated queries and reporting for automation-related operations.

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Job ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: job_phase_id
fields.description: Job stage ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Job script/tool ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: fail_policy
fields.description: Failure policy: ignore failures, stop on failure.

fields.name: parent_operation_type
fields.description: Parent tool type, such as if-block's if|else.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_jobid_operationId
indexes.description: Standard index covering the job_id, operation_id fields, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_phaseid_opid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the job_phase_id, operation_id fields, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
